name: @gjsify/webkit-native-darwin-arm64
description: darwin-arm64 prebuilt native library + GObject-Introspection typelib for @gjsify/webkit-native. Installed automatically on darwin/arm64 as an optionalDependency of that package (ADR 0017) and skipped everywhere else. Contains no JavaScript.

platformsUncommitted.darwin-arm64: prebuilds.yml's `build-prebuilds-macos` job builds this on its macos-latest (arm64) leg, but that job is opt-in behind the `ci:macos` label and the host that authored the package is an Intel VM, so no arm64 binary has been produced yet to commit. The x64 sibling is committed and loads. Closing this is one labelled CI run, not code: the Objective-C is architecture-independent and the meson build has no arch branch.
